text:
Predicates:
PublishingHouse(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
Specialize(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Published(x, y) ::: x published y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Language(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
Translated(x, y) ::: x was translated from y.
Premises:
PublishingHouse(newVesselPress) ∧ Specialize(newVesselPress, translatingForeignLiterature) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house which specializes in translating foreign literature into English.
∀x (Published(newVesselPress, x) → Language(x, english)) ::: All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
Book(neapolitanChronicles) ∧ Published(newVesselPress, neapolitanChronicles) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Translated(neapolitanChronicles, italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
Book(palaceOfFlies) ∧ Published(newVesselPress, palaceOfFlies) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
Language(neapolitanChronicles, english) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is an English book.
